description.en:
As a "love appraiser", she helps wives "verify" their husbands' sincerity as "the ideal woman" who fulfills all men's fantasies. With her heaven-sent appearance and career mission to undermine the feelings of others, is she guarding "true love" or just destroying it? Is she exposing lies or creating tragedies?
Some say that this comic depicts the sin of men's desire, women's distrust of love, and the self-restraint of people in a romantic relationship.

However, when Wen Xuran was performing his mission, he discovered that Kyle was related to the murderer that killed his parents! In order to uncover the truth behind his parents' death, Wen Xuran decided to get closer to Kyle first...

description.en: When **Anomaly Zones** descend across the globe, terror becomes the new normal. Twisted anomalies stalk the streets, and only the Exorcists, humans who dare to fight back, stand between survival and annihilation. But to truly end the madness, they must conquer the core world behind each Zone… and most never return. As humanity teeters on the edge, *Chu Sheng* awakens a game-breaking **Custom Cheat-Shop System**. Every time he enters a new Zone, he chooses a powerful ability, tailored to dominate the horrors within. While other Exorcists struggle just to survive, the monsters kneel before him. This is the story of a man who turns **Anomaly Zones** into his personal playground.

description.en:
The two-way crush between the super-powered male lead and the super-delusional female lead can succeed or not?
Mo Er (male protagonist) is the youngest director of the film and television center of the Rong Media Center, and is also a super-powered person with the ability to "read minds". What he admires most is imaginative people, and he has a rookie intern Li Yitian (the female lead), who has excellent imagination. But she often makes up for the various plays with him as the protagonist. Mo Er is both troubled and enjoys the joy of being "secretly in love" by Li Yitian. He has been waiting for Li Yitian to confess to him, but he doesn't know that Li Yitian is using him as the material for his comics. Will Li Yitian, who has been YY Mo Er all day, also like Mo Er?

He is the scary and arrogant underworld mogul. In one day he became that Yin Yang master's 'slave'. Everyday, he work as hard as a bull and lets people order him around, and he also gets molested till he can't fight back! Also….he should be getting mad but why can't he get mad at that chilly figure? A gorgeous but strange demon's story. The entanglement of the previous life and the present…waiting for you to open

Zhong Kui, in traditional Chinese culture he was a god who was skilled at dispelling ghosts and other evils. He was born with a fierce and atrocious face. While he was quite ugly, he was also brilliant, outspoken, and tenacious.  
  
This story is not entirely based on tradition. It follows Zhong Kui through a fantasy world of ying and yang.

The orphaned survivor of the annihilated Qiongqi clan, Hao, becomes a disciple of the mysterious Ghost Immortal Liu Tan. Within the Ghost Immortal Sect, he trains with unwavering focus and takes on missions alongside his senior brother Ye, vowing to uncover the enemy responsible for his clan’s destruction.

A sudden transmigration cycle occurred, breaking the norms of a normal high school student, from that day onward, he enjoy the company of otherworlders but how he adapts to the comedic and absurd lifestyle when the impending threat of the world looms near…  
  
高中少年倪枫的日常生活被一连串离奇的穿越事件打破，从此他和穿越而来的人们一起过着没羞没臊的日子，但是这看似荒诞可笑的的生活却并没有那么简单，世界真正劫难正悄然临近……

description.fr:
Elle est la fille légitime du Premier ministre et consacre sa vie à la vengeance. 
Il est un prince invincible et impitoyable, mais s'engage à l'aimer pour le reste de sa vie. Entre eux, il n'y a pas seulement la différence de statut, mais aussi les intrigues de leurs ennemis. 
Pourront-ils changer leur destin et tenir la promesse qu'ils n'ont pas pu tenir dans leur vie précédente ?

description.en: There are strange things happening in school.

Venant d'endroit mystérieux, les créatures grises et pourpres entrent en collision sur terre. Ils réussissent à transformer autant d’humains qu’ils peuvent en leur propre espèce. Xiao Cheng et Zheng Yiren, meilleurs amis de l’enfance, ont été transformés en rouge et gris respectivement. Debout sur les idéaux opposés, face à ce monde en train de s’effondrer, quels choix feront les deux frères ?

Hoi Fu, is a rich playboy during the day. At night, he is hero for the people, known as the Sea Tiger. He fights a world renown organization lead by Blue Dream. Blue Dream wanted to conquer the world and destroy everything on Earth so that it could be restored into an unpolluted state like it used to be. Full of action, drama and mind-twisting plot.

Yashi has wandered with her father for fourteen years, and only now has she discovered that her own mother is actually Bocinia’s current queen. To see her mother, from whom she was separated when she was just an infant, she and her father enter the palace, but she never thought she would accidentally run into the Princess of Bocinia, and then become her bodyguard by mistake…  
  
NOTE: This manhua ends at Volume 4. The continuation of the story was written in a novel.
Drama dances with death, truth is hidden in applause.

description.en:
ue to family reasons, Zongzheng Yue completely loathes otakus. He was originally living an ordinary life, but littering a soda can on a certain day triggered a series of events, and made a nonsensical girl who professed to be an otaku god enter his life. Under the otaku god’s instructions, Yue has no choice but to start learning how to become an otaku. Then, his loli senior and childhood sweetheart also began to enter Yue's life under the supreme otaku god Lan Ling's "interference".  
  
Adapted from the Novel "My Ordinary Life Does Not Need An Otaku God".

But one day, she meets a tough opponent. Since phone calls don't work, she brings her men to knock on his door, only to discover that he is a super handsome boy who is actually her schoolmate! Handsome boy: If you don't want to be exposed, become my slave~ Thus, the school life of the tyrannical girl and the sadistic prince, which is full of battles and clashes, begins.

description.en:
Traveling through the world of immortal cultivation, Wang Xiu discovered that he could see other people's. He could help others resolve bad omens and copy other people's abilities. So whenever someone was in danger, Wang Xiu would descend from the sky. Thousands of years later, almost all the living geniuses, powerful people, fairies, and demon women owed Wang Xiu their lives... 

Dan Fairy: Brother has saved me nine times. I can't repay you for your kindness, so I can only repay you with my body! 

Jian Fairy: Brother has saved me thirty-two times. It is reasonable for me to give him thirty-two sons, isn't it? 

White-clothed Empress: He has saved me one hundred and eight times. Are you sure you want to compete with me? 

Lie Tian Emperor: Big brother has saved me three hundred and twenty-one times. The person who is most qualified to stand by his side is me! ! !

When demons from another realm tear open the heavens and the cultivation world teeters on the brink of destruction, the only hope rests in a single "mortal" — Yín Yuè — whose very use of spiritual power draws divine lightning down upon her head. Is she the hidden deity the world believes her to be, or the greatest nemesis of the demon saint Móluó? Yín Yuè only wishes to sip tea and admire flowers — yet without realizing it, she twirls the fate of the Nine Realms around her fingertips.

After her life took a U-turn, she buried her past and became a tough policewoman. However, years into her career in uniform, she reencounters the man from her bitter-sweet memory.   
  
Now a sharp-tongued detective, he meets the girl that he used to share cherished moments with. Together, they will seek justice and rekindle what was once between them.  
  
A story of crime investigation, also about how they become each other’s salvation.

麥仁寶，一名就讀超人學院的十五歲少年，擁有夢到自己會發生什麼「衰事」，卻對世界一點幫助也沒有的「預知」能力。沒想到，這次他竟夢到自己下半身被一名少女和一名女惡魔撕成兩半的恐怖惡夢？之後，麥仁寶不但在學校驚見和夢中一模一樣的少女，還因為愛惹麻煩的父親召喚了魔界的撒旦，意外碰到了夢中的女惡魔！眼見劇情急轉直下，天神、魔鬼、機器人都來湊熱鬧，該不會惡夢就要成真？

biography.en:
She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.
